Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/12] The analyses of the CBCL sub-scale Internalisation Problems revealed no significant group, time, or interaction (group time) effects. [/page/3/Text/13] Significant time effects were found on the SPPC subscale Global Self-worth and on the CDI scores. [/page/3/Text/14] No significant effects were found on the STAIC and CBCL sub-scales Anxious/Depressed between the pretest and the post-test.
